```{r}
# Load tidyverse
library(tidyverse)

# Read the data
nyc_data <- read_csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PPBDS/primer.data/master/data-raw/nyc_tracts.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Clean the data
nyc_clean <- nyc_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(med_income), !is.na(race)) %>%
  mutate(race = factor(race, levels = c("White", "Hispanic", "Black", "Asian")))

# Plot the data
ggplot(nyc_clean, aes(x = med_income, y = race)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = med_income), width = 0, height = 0.25, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Median Income") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format()) +
  labs(title = "Income Distribution by Racial Majority in NYC Census Tracts",
    subtitle = "Each dot represents a census tract, grouped by largest racial group.",
    x = "Median Household Income",
    y = "Largest Racial Group",
    caption = "Source: PPBDS NYC Census Tract Data") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom")

```
